## Checklist

- [ ] Every "done when" box in the feature file is ticked
- [ ] Rules in the service's `docs/invariants.md` still hold
- [ ] Tests were written first, and no test was weakened to pass
- [ ] The OpenAPI file is updated if an endpoint changed
- [ ] CI is green
- [ ] Review done (two passes at most). Minor findings are in the service's `BACKLOG.md`
- [ ] No secrets in the diff
- [ ] PR title uses the Conventional Commit format
